prompt_head:
You design feature-development tasks for benchmarking AI coding agents.
The tasks are built on a real open-source repository at a fixed commit. Each task asks an agent to
implement ONE new feature; hi

{
  "ideas": [
    {
      "title": "Add Regex ParamType for regular expression pattern matching validation",
      "family": "data_validation",
      "difficulty": "intermediate",
      "target_file": "src/click/types.py",
      "touches": ["ParamType", "convert"],
      "new_names": ["Regex"],
      "summary": "Introduce a `Regex` parameter type (`click.Regex(pattern, flags=0, error_message=None)`). When converting a string value, it validates the string against the compiled regular expression. If the pattern does not match, it raises `BadParameter` with either the custom `error_message` or a default message displaying the value and pattern.",
      "why_new": "Click's `types.py` provides `Choice`, `IntRange`, `FloatRange`, `DateTime`, `Path`, and `File`, but lacks a general pattern-matching parameter type for validating arbitrary string formats such as UUIDs, semver strings, or custom codes."
    },

      "difficulty": "intermediate",
      "target_file": "src/click/types.py",

If validation fails, it raises `BadParameter` explicitly identifying which complexity requirement was not met.",
      "why_new": "Click currently has basic string types and `password_option` for masking input, but lacks a parameter type for validating complexity and length rules on secrets, passwords, or token options."

      "title": "Add environment profile registration and selection to CliRunner",
